items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-10-21
items.q: I think I've heard Willie do that sometimes. Willie sometimes plays off it.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. I'll make it, trust me, I'll make it do that, you know. But I never pop a weed, I never drive the pop a weed. I like, you know, some of you do top, make it pop. But I never, I never like it.
Yes, that's what they call slack timing, I think. Yeah. I think I've heard Willie do that sometimes. Willie sometimes plays off it.

That's what I was the first one, I didn't want to say the name, what he do sometimes. It's just a chance of tone around. But I like a tone, and what put me on the tone, because when I first started playing it, I like all the young people in Screens, you know. And the general who lived in the same, he used to, I asked me, hey, upstairs, what about the moorys, you know. They make that funny noise. They make that funny noise.
